jobs.title: Talent Sourcing Specialist
jobs.description: ❮ back to last search Weekday India 0-4.2 per year Contract Full time Apply for this jobThis role is for one of our clients Industry: Marketing ServicesCompany Name: IndieFolio Seniority level: Associate level Min Experience: 1+ yearsLocation: Remote (India)JobType: full-time ₹3,80,000 - ₹4,20,000 a yearTalent Sourcing Specialist — Find India's Best Creative Minds At IndieFolio, we're building the future of creative work — connecting top brands with exceptional talent across design, video, and content. As our Talent Sourcing Specialist, your one job is to find, engage, and pipeline the best creative professionals in the country before anyone else does. This is a pure sourcing role. You'll master the craft of identifying and attracting talent. What You'll Do: Sourcing & Talent Identification Proactively scout top-tier creative professionals across disciplines — graphic design, motion, UX/UI, copywriting, video production, and more — for both full-time and contract roles. Build and maintain a living, breathing talent pipeline across platforms: LinkedIn, Behance, Dribbble, Instagram, and beyond. Develop creative search strategies to surface passive talent who aren't actively job hunting but are exactly who our brands need. Maintain a diverse pool of freelancers and full-timers to address the full spectrum of creative hiring needs across industries. Screening & Assessment Review portfolios and conduct preliminary screening to assess creative quality, culture fit, and role alignment. Deliver a consistent, high-quality candidate experience from first outreach to handoff. Pipeline & Data Management Own and update the talent database — tracking sourcing activity, pipeline health, and candidate status across all open roles. Report on sourcing metrics and continuously refine your approach based on what's working. What You'll Bring: 6 months of experience in talent sourcing or recruitment, ideally within creative, design, or marketing fields. A sharp eye for creative quality — you know good work when you see it. Experience sourcing for both full-time and freelance/contract roles. Familiarity with sourcing tools and platforms used in the creative industry. Strong written communication skills for compelling outreach that actually gets replies. Organized, data-driven, and comfortable managing multiple open pipelines simultaneously. Why Join Us: Work with the best — your sourcing directly impacts campaigns and products for leading global brands. Hypergrowth trajectory — be part of a company scaling 100x in 3 years. Remote-first — own your schedule, focus on results. High-trust culture — your judgment matters here. No micromanagement. Continuous growth — training, mentorship, and a team that genuinely invests in your development. Competitive compensation — salary, benefits, and room to grow. Must-have skills Talent sourcing, Recruitment, Creative industry sourcing Good-to-have skills Talent Acquisition, Hiring, Niche Talent Acquisition We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. jobs.description: <p> <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote, US </p> <p><strong>Description</strong></p> <p>Keeper is hiring a motivated Associate Talent Acquisition Partner to support the full cycle recruiting process. This is a 100% remote position from select locations with an opportunity to work a hybrid schedule for candidates based in the Chicago, IL metro area.&nbsp;</p> <p>Keeper’s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organizations globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and is sold in over 150 countries. Join one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies and be responsible for a variety of recruiting support activities from reviewing applications, to sourcing candidates and facilitating new hire on-boarding logistics.</p> <p><strong>About Keeper</strong></p> <p>Keeper Security is one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity software companies that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in over 150 countries. Keeper is a pioneer of zero-knowledge and zero-trust security built for any IT environment. Its core offering, KeeperPAM®, is an AI-enabled, cloud-native platform that protects all users, devices and infrastructure from cyber attacks.
